title: Which Way? Modulus and Argument Explained Simply | PUC Maths Class 11
description:
Two cyclists both end up 5 km from the same gate. Are they in the same place? Not always: distance is not enough, you also need a direction. In this animated lesson for PUC and Class 11 Maths (NCERT Chapter 4, Complex Numbers and Quadratic Equations) we measure a complex number as a trip: how far it goes (the modulus) and which way it points (the argument).

You will see the modulus built from Pythagoras step by step, then watch a live trip around the origin with |z| and arg z updating every frame while the conjugate z bar mirrors it. We learn the principal argument (between -pi and pi, -pi left out), find it quadrant by quadrant, compare z with z bar and with -z, work out -1 - root 3 i, and fix the classic tan inverse trap. The modulus is in the current NCERT text; the argument is not in the current NCERT text but is listed in the JEE Main syllabus. Two pause-and-think questions, an original JEE Main pattern question with a full solution, a recap card and three questions to check yourself.

Made for PUC (Karnataka), CBSE Class 11 and JEE Main students.

In this video:

3:39 Worked example: -1 - root 3 i
